method: Fresh delegated context; read-only adversarial source review. No production/test edits, Git mutations, server launch, private-journal or credential reads, or external model calls.

additional_criteria.evidence: packages/core/src/agents-chat.ts:chatSend reuses launchAgentTask; packages/core/src/agents-runs.ts retains Foundation plan/enqueue/budget admission and assertNotBusy.

packages/core/src/agents-chat-progress.ts:chatProgress validates lease, dispatch grant, live task/run/profile, abort, run expiry, provider identity and sequence before durable publication; lease/dispatch are rechecked after awaited operations.

packages/core/src/agents-execution.ts:observe and packages/core/src/agents.ts:settlement preserve revoked cancellation, epoch/profile checks, physical-stop proof and output suppression; chatOutputs only accepts successful noncancelled final output.

packages/core/src/agents-chat-state.ts:chatHistory includes only bounded successful same-conversation pairs; scripts/hermes_gateway_state.py:identity hashes the complete conversation alongside task/profile/scope/correlation/deadline.

scripts/hermes_agent_boot.py:BoundedAgent checks actual native empty tools/provider/endpoint/output cap and overrides all tool dispatch seams; scripts/hermes_gateway_reply.py:validated_frames rejects tool-bearing, oversized, foreign-model and incomplete frames before forwarding each frame.

scripts/hermes_gateway.py:run requires broker.reply_validated and joined event reader before terminal success; scripts/hermes_gateway_transport.py:observed does not copy the mutable requests counter; scripts/hermes_gateway_broker.py retains physical request count/inflight ownership through stop.

apps/control-api/src/agent-chat-transport.ts:registerAgentChatTransport bounds connection count, per-conversation count, stream lifetime, unread consumer, poll/heartbeat and periodic same-owner/session authentication; close/cancel/abort release capacity independently of task execution.

packages/core/src/agents-chat-outputs.ts validates finite strict structured blocks and exact UTF-8 bytes/digest, derives safe server names and never resolves model paths/URLs; apps/control-api/src/agent-chat-transport.ts uses attachment text/plain, nosniff, sandbox and private no-store; console renders React text/pre content.

packages/core/src/agents-chat-outputs.ts:chatResolve checks exact stored proposal/plan/scope/hash/revision/target/command/expiry, requires fresh owner for approval and invokes Foundation.approveInTransaction inside the same write transaction as proposal state, receipt and audit. No native broad grants or independent enqueue introduced.

apps/console/src/components/agents-chat.tsx: drafts and frozen send intention are stored by conversation ID; exact original body/revision is retained for uncertain retry. apps/console/src/components/agents-panel.tsx: failed requests retain the idempotency key keyed by method/path/exact JSON body. UI keeps owner history visible while stale/paused profiles block new sends and approval.

resolved_observations.original_issue: A cursor read at 256 followed by one append/prune could return events 2..257 to after=0 without reset if metadata and events were read outside one transaction.
resolved_observations.refutation: The UI already detects gaps and refetches, preventing silent concatenation, but that does not satisfy the server explicit-reset contract.
resolved_observations.resolution: packages/core/src/agents-chat-state.ts:readChatEvents now encloses cursor validation and event selection in the shared serialized write() transaction used by append/prune.

resolved_observations.original_issue: Owner history, retained events and artifacts were unnecessarily blocked by profile pause/reconfiguration because read and admission shared mandatory currentProfile validation.
resolved_observations.resolution: conversationFor defaults to owner read access; chatSend and approve request requireActive=true. Progress independently retains its current-profile authority checks. History and rejection remain available after protective changes.

not_reviewed: Independent execution of Vitest, browser, native delayed-stream or truncated-DONE fixtures: GAUNTLET/root own those gates; this is source review, not a runtime attestation.
Independent lint/type/build/dependency/scanner execution: root owns executable gates; no claim of completed executable qualification is made here.
Paid provider behavior, deployed-host containment, remote/server operation and continuous autonomy are outside the authorized local scope.
Private runtime journals, bindings and credentials were deliberately excluded.
All unrelated preexisting uncommitted Agent Center work was treated as baseline; no full-repository audit is claimed.
